user.title: Set up UBA air quality index
user.description: Stations are searched around a location and their data is combined into one air quality index.

data_description.location_source: Use the Home Assistant home location or pick coordinates on a map.
data_description.radius_km: Only stations within this radius are offered. Ozone is a regional pollutant; a second station up to about 25 km away is a reasonable supplement if the nearest station does not measure ozone.

select_stations.title: Select stations
select_stations.description: {count} active stations found within {radius} km, sorted by distance. Select the nearest station; add a second station if it fills a gap (for example ozone).

error.cannot_connect: The Umweltbundesamt API could not be reached.
error.no_stations_found: No active station within the radius. Increase the search radius.
error.station_already_configured: At least one selected station is already part of another entry.

data_description.update_interval_minutes: The Umweltbundesamt publishes new values once per hour, typically 50 minutes past the hour.

update_failed.message: Fetching data from the Umweltbundesamt API failed: {error}

station_silent.title: Station {station} is not delivering data
station_silent.description: The measuring station {station} has not delivered any data since {last}. Its sensors are shown as unavailable. If the station stays silent, replace it via the reconfigure option of the integration entry.
